svg.aria-label: How to write வ, க: 2 letters, வ, க, one after another
svg.title: Writing வ, க
svg.desc: 2 letters written one after another: வ, க (tamil). Each letter has its own group of frames; frame N of a group shows movements 1 to N of that letter, the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansTamil-Static.ttf. Each letter is drawn at its own scale from its own cited stroke order, so the strip does not show how large the letters are next to each other, how far apart they sit, or any join between them. Stroke order: வ: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 9, வ (Univ. of Texas at Austin), p. 194 <https://sites.la.utexas.edu/tamilscript/files/2009/08/hw_lettersinstructions.pdf>; க: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 3, க (Univ. of Texas at Austin), p. 191 <https://sites.la.utexas.edu/tamilscript/files/2009/08/hw_lettersinstructions.pdf>. Source notes on variation: வ: Tamil handwriting is taught with school-to-school variation; there is no single national stroke-order standard. This is one attested order. க: Tamil handwriting is taught with school-to-school variation; there is no single national stroke-order standard. Appendix I Frame 3 numbers six hand-movements for க. Native writers draw them as one continuous stroke, and this ductus follows the six movements in order without lifting: the pen returns up the lower-left bowl's outer side to the middle left and crosses the middle bar into the lower-right bowl. In HP Labs India's online Tamil handwriting data (the LipiTk 4.0 Tamil isolated-character recognizer, trained on hpl-tamil-iso-char), 88% of the 203 stored prototypes of க are a single pen-down stroke.
svg.text: How it is written — 2 letters, one after another
Letter 1 of 2 — one unbroken stroke · 5 movements
Letter 2 of 2 — one unbroken stroke · 6 movements
Letter 1: stroke order after Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 9, வ (Univ. of Texas at Austin), p. 194
Letter 2: stroke order after Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 3, க (Univ. of Texas at Austin), p. 191
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
